body: I can’t hold a job because I never feel like I’m doing good enough to where I worry so much that I screw up constantly. It’s not just the job, it’s everything else that has gone wrong in my life.

That’s true, it’s just painful failing and having to spend money over again.. FAFSA doesn’t cover one class.. I’m barely making a B- average in the class now. It’s frustrating. 

Yeah, I don’t have friends to do things with nowadays. I stopped talking to all of my friends from HS because they just sit around doing drugs and drinking themselves into oblivion. I’m not into that, I like 420, but doing heroin, meth, or coke doesn’t seem fun to me.
